name: Music
overview: Scripture reveals music as a divinely ordained means of worship and celebration, exemplified in Moses and the Israelites singing praises to the LORD for His mighty deliverance (Exodus 15:1-4). Music is closely associated with joy and reverence, as seen in the invitation to depart with mirth and songs (Genesis 31:27), and its origins are traced to Jubal, the father of those skilled in harp and organ (Genesis 4:21). The LORD Himself is described as both strength and song, underscoring music's integral role in honoring God and acknowledging His salvation.
